Name: -CP- Penny Seasonal Outfits Mk II
Author: TallLeprechaun13
Description:
Artwork was done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/suzukiPC]Pau[/url].
If you wish to modify any parts and post it to a mod site, I must first be asked which will then be forwarded to Pau to determine.

The Spirit's Eve outfit is based off of Mrs. Brisby from the movie "The Secret of NIMH" (1982) by Don Bluth based off of the book by Robert O'Brien "Mrs. Frisby and the Rats of NIMH"
[u]
Mod Includes[/u]:
[list]
[*]3 outfits per season with rain and sun variants[/*]
[*]Beach and Snorkeling outfit[/*]
[*]Spouse Portrait that adjusts with what config settings are chosen[/*]
[*]Festival outfits for: Desert Festival, Egg Festival, Feast of Winter Star, Ice Festival, Flower Dance, 
                              Luau, Moonlight Jellies, Night Market, Spirit's Eve, and Stardew Fair[/*]
[/list]
[u]Mod Options[/u]:
Hair and Elven Ear: Ginger, Ginger & Elf Ear, Auburn, and Auburn & Elf Ear
Eye Colour: Green, Blue, Purple, and Grey
Beach Skin: Only Beach Skin, Only Snorkeling Skin, Both

[u]Mod Compatibility[/u]: 
It should be compatible with outfit mods that are for everyone (Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic), [u][b]but it will overwrite their Penny outfits[/b][/u]. However, with how appearance modding works, it is either theirs takes precedence or this one does, you cannot easily mix and match. Please message if you have questions.
